description: This PHP source file defines the class `PrepareBodyMiddleware` within the GuzzleHttp namespace. The class is middleware used to prepare HTTP requests containing a body by adding necessary headers such as Content-Length, Content-Type, and Expect. It handles modification of requests before they are sent, based on request properties and options, to ensure proper headers are set for HTTP communication.

classes.name: PrepareBodyMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for preparing HTTP request bodies by setting appropriate headers before request dispatch.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler callable in the chain.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, modifying the request to include necessary headers based on the request content and options.

methods.description: Private method to add the Expect header to the request when applicable, based on request properties and options.
